text_block_list.text:
At dusk. While chasing after Twin Turbo
as she ran around playing in the downtown district...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer!
I found something that looks super fun!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Look, right over there!

Looking ahead... a crowd of people had gathered for some reason.
Peeking over to see what was going on...

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle is underway~!
The grand prize is an all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
2nd prize is "Mountain of Carrots"!
3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"Step right up, step right up, it's the fun, fun lottery!
You there, little Umamusume,
wanna draw a ticket?"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
A lottery!? I'm in!!
Trainer, gimme the ticket!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Eeeek, then I won't be able to pull!
No, no, no, no waaaay~!!

text_block_list.name: Downtown Grandma
text_block_list.text:
There, there, don't cry, young lady.
Here, use this.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Oh! Thank you, Grandma!
Thanks to the kindness of a friendly old lady from downtown, Twin Turbo received a single raffle ticket.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, Trainer. I'll let you spin
the raffle wheel with Turbo!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Turbo is definitely gonna win first prize!
Ready, set, vrooooooom!!!!!!!

Spinning the raffle wheel at high speed,
just like a 16-cylinder turbo engine!
And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!!
The Grand Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been won~~~~!!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Grand prize? Aw, man.
So it's not 1st place then...
choice_data_list: Wait, this is even higher than 1st prize!?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Really!!? So it's the jackpot!!!!?
Yaaayyyyyy!!!!!!

Twin Turbo rejoices with sheer delight.
She magnificently drew the hot spring trip ticket.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
A hot spring! Hot springs, huh... What should I do
once we get to the hot springs~?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
First, we charge into the washing area, right?
Then, we splash hot water back and forth with everyone around us~

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ah, hot spring eggs sound nice too~. If I hold raw
eggs in both hands and just step right in~
choice_data_list: Then I can't take you with me...
Then I can't take you with me...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Huh, why, why!?
Turbo wants to go, so why can't I!?
choice_data_list: First, you need to learn proper manners.

text_block_list.text: "Even if things get wild on the track, that won't fly in public. Observing good manners was an absolute requirement."

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
All right, got it! Then Turbo's
gonna practice behaving herself!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: So if I pass, can we go to the hot springs?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Yay! Now I'm gonna go quietly soak in the dorm's big bath with Bakushin O right away!

...No matter how I think about it,
I can't imagine her bathing quietly.
Still, I've got something great to look forward to!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~!
The prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Oho, I won something that looks super delicious!! Yay, yay~~!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Since we hit the jackpot with such a lavish prize, we should add even more toppings to make it super colorful!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Um... mayo, mustard...
chocolate... shrimp... strawberry gummies...
choice_data_list: Uh-huh, feel free to do whatever you like.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Fufun, I'll give you half too, Trainer!
I hurriedly stopped her. Afterwards, we thoroughly enjoyed the hamburger steak without any toppings.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!!
The prize is a "Mountain of Carrots"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, I won a whole bunch!
Hooray!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: "With this many, there's so much we can do before eating them! We could even line them up and pretend to have a car race."

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, and then maybe we can do that thing!
Playing pretend Nature!"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Yes! Sticking two horns straight out of her head, making an ogre-like face. And her complexion was—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
It's bright red just like that sunset!
Looks just like Nature when she's angry!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ohooo? Turbo, dear.
Care to say who she looks like just one more time?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Geh, Nature?!
Why are you here?!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I'm always around! Don't underestimate
the pride of the downtown district! Hey, Turbo!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Gyaaaaah,
they really are spitting images of each other!!

Twin Turbo ran around before eating.
Thanks to that built-up hunger, the carrots tasted even more delicious.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
3rd prize~!
The prize is "one carrot"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh, only one~?
That's kind of boring~.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, Trainer. There was this old fairy tale about growing more carrots in a field...
Is that actually real?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I see. In that case, maybe
I should give that method a try!

The multiplication method Twin Turbo had heard about
from a fairy tale was...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: "First, you see, you plant a carrot in the field. Then, when you water it..."

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
They say the carrots swell up plump and get bigger and bigger.
And after a little more time passes—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
They said it goes 'KABOOM!'
and a ton of carrots come bursting out!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Fufun, it's totally worth a try!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh, why not~?
I won't know if you don't tell me!!
"...I kind of get it. So I just quietly gave the single carrot to Twin Turbo as a snack."

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost!
Your consolation prize is a pack of tissues~
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Uuu... Tissues...
And just one pack...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Waaaaaahhhhh!!!!!
I don't want this, no, no, no waaaayyyy!!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Turbo wanted first place, waaaah!!
Waaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
No no no no waaaay! I'm not gonna
listen to you! No waaaay!!!!!

A massive miss sends her into full-blown tantrum mode...
Once she gets like this, there's no controlling her whatsoever...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: No no no, no waaaaay!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: *ding*!!!!

"Even so... she blew her nose without complaint.
That was the only use for those unfortunate tissues."
